contract: surface: Personal portfolio (single page) for Divik Bhaskar, backend/cloud security engineer | job: Recruiters and engineers decide in under a minute what he is best at, then verify it through skills, projects, GitHub, LinkedIn and résumé | primaryAction: Open GitHub / LinkedIn / résumé; secondary: explore About -> Skills -> Projects filters | tone: Editorial and restrained: serif headings, neutral warm palette, one burnt-orange accent, thin rules instead of cards | memorableDetail: Linked filtering: an About area highlights its skills, a skill highlights the projects built with it | hierarchy: Hero statement > section label column > row content > metadata in mono | constraints: Vite + React + Tailwind v4 tokens via CSS variables; light and dark via prefers-color-scheme; WCAG AA text contrast; reduced-motion respected; no new dependencies | reference: Local: previous neon version of this repo was rejected by the user as 'vibe coded'; direction chosen to remove gradients, glow, particle canvas and card grids

accessibility.evidence: Real Tab key presses in Chrome: focus lands on nav links with :focus-visible 2px accent outline (desktop-1440-focus.png). All 54 visible links/buttons have text or aria-label. Contrast measured: body text 15.68:1, muted 4.79:1, accent 5.01:1 (light); muted 6.3:1, accent 6.57:1 (dark). Dialog has role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, autofocuses Close, closes on Escape (verified). Menu button has aria-expanded. prefers-reduced-motion rule present and disables transitions/animations. Skill chips are 36px min height.

responsive.evidence: 1440x900: two-column section layout with sticky labels, no horizontal overflow. 390x844 (mobile, touch, dpr 2): single column, hamburger menu opens with 7 items, skill chips wrap cleanly, no element extends past the viewport (scrollWidth - innerWidth = 0, zero overflowing elements), long email wraps with break-all.

loading.reason: Static site with all content bundled at build time; no runtime data fetching, so there is no loading phase beyond the initial page load.

empty.evidence: Hosted apps have no URLs yet: rows say what is coming and 'Open app' opens a 'Coming soon / Not deployed yet' dialog with a Close action (desktop-1440-coming-soon.png). Skills with no linked project render as dashed, non-interactive tags instead of dead buttons.

error.reason: No forms, network requests or user input that can fail at runtime; external links open in new tabs and failures there are outside this page.

partial.evidence: Filtered views show a subset while keeping the rest visible but faded: clicking C++ highlights 3 projects with an accent bar and fades 2 (desktop-1440-filtered-projects.png); banner states the filter and offers 'Back to skills' and 'Show all'.

success.evidence: Selecting an About area or skill scrolls to the target section (top offset 64px measured) and confirms with a banner naming the selection, plus a clear way back and reset.

permission.reason: Public portfolio with no authentication, roles or gated content.

renderedEvidence.observation: Light mode first viewport: availability line, serif hero statement with accent phrase, four text links; nav with résumé link.
Keyboard focus outline visible on the 'About' nav link after two Tab presses.
Projects filtered by C++: banner at top, matching rows with accent left bar, non-matching rows faded.
Coming soon dialog over dimmed page with focused Close button.
Dark mode mobile hero: headline wraps in 5 lines without clipping, links wrap to one row.
Dark mode mobile skills: group label above chips, chips wrap with counts, dashed tags for skills without projects.
